THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 -6-  NC: 2023:KHC-D:8849  MFA No. 21963 of 2012  C/W MFA No. 21964 of 2012,

 MFA No. 21966 of 2012,
 MFA No. 21967 of 2012  JUDGMENT

These appeals are filed by the appellant-owner of Maruti Omni car bearing No.KA-47/M 1446 challenging the judgment and award dated 31.12.2011 passed in MVC.Nos.94/2010, 95/2010,
96/2010, 97/2010 and MVC.No.106/2010 by the Addl. MACT, Kumta, questioning the liability fastened on the appellant-owner to pay compensation.
2. The factum of accident is not in dispute.

3. Heard the arguments from both sides and perused the records.
4.

Learned counsel for the appellant-owner submitted that Maruti Omni car bearing No.KA-47/M 1446 was not used on hire basis and one Yakoob Ismail Shamali was traveling from Kumta to Goa since he was going aboard.
Therefore, for the purpose of dropping Yakoob Ismail Shamali, all claimants had gone to Goa Airport and NC: 2023:KHC-D:8849 C/W MFA No. 21964 of 2012, MFA No. 21965 of 2012, MFA No. 21966 of 2012
, while returning to Kumta, the accident was caused.
They have contended that the claimants and Yakoob Ismail Shamali are the friends of appellant-owner.
Hence, the appellant-owner has not received any fare either from the claimants or from Yakoob Ismail Shamali.
Therefore, the vehicle is not used on hire or reward basis.
Hence, the Insurance Company is liable to indemnify the appellant- owner and pay compensation to the claimants.

5. On the other hand, learned counsel for respondent No.2-Insurance Company submitted that the Maruti Omni car bearing No.KA-47/M 1446 was used on hire basis to drop Yakoob Ismail Shamali to Goa Airport and while returning to Kumta, the accident was occurred.
Further submitted that there is no proof that the appellant - owner, Yakoob Ismail Shamali and the claimants are close friends in order to drop Yakoob Ismail Shamali to Goa Airport.
Therefore, submitted that the Maruti Omni car NC: 2023:KHC-D:8849 C/W MFA No. 21964 of 2012, MFA No. 21965 of 2012, MFA No. 21966 of 2012, was used on hire basis for going from Kumta to Goa.

entities.text: Maruti Omni car NC: 2023:KHC-D:8849 C/W MFA No. 21964 of 2012
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Hence, the vehicle is a non-transport vehicle, but it is used for commercial purpose by receiving hire.
Therefore, in this regard, the Tribunal has correctly assessed the evidence and fastened the liability on the appellant-owner.

6. In the present case, the claimants and Yakoob Ismail Shamali had traveled from Kumta to Goa for dropping Yakoob Ismail Shamali to Goa Airport and while returning from Goa to Kumta, the Kiran Sanjeev Sudhakar vs Bibi Aseesha Abdul Hasan Shamali on 11 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/157668287/

sentences.text:
It is the submission of the learned counsel for the appellant-owner that the claimants are friends and they know each other for years together and therefore, on friendship basis,
Maruti Omni car was taken to Goa.

The Tribunal had observed that the appellant-owner and claimants are belonging to different religion and in the evidence, it is revealed that both are situated in different villages that is 20 kms away from each others place.
Therefore, it is opined that the Maruti Omni car was used on hire basis.
Hence, exonerated the Insurance Company from paying compensation.
7. Except the oral evidence on the part of the appellant-owner, there is no other evidence.

But in the course of cross-examination, the learned counsel for respondent No.2-Insurance Company had suggested the claimants that the Maruti Omni car was taken on hire basis, but the claimants have stated that they do not know as to what was the conversation between the appellant- owner and Yakoob Ismail Shamali.
The said Yakoob Ismail Shamali had engaged the said car.
In the course of cross- examination of PW.2 who is the claimant in MVC.No.96/2010 had admitted that Yakoob Ismail Shamali has made conversation with the appellant-owner and brought the car.

Therefore,
when the entire evidence are considered on all its preponderance of probabilities, it is - 10 - NC: 2023:KHC-D:8849 C/W MFA No. 21964 of 2012, MFA No. 21965 of 2012, MFA No. 21966 of 2012, proved that the Maruti Omni car was used on hire basis.
It is revealed in the evidence that previous to the accident for about 2 to 3 times, the appellant-owner has taken Yakoob Ismail Shamali and claimants to Goa for dropping him to Goa Airport.
8. Therefore, it is difficult to believe that the appellant -owner has used the Maruti Omni car for giving free service to the claimants.
Therefore, appellant-owner has used the Maruti Omni car on hire basis for taking the claimants and Yakoob Ismail Shamali to Goa Airport.
If frequently Maruti Omni car is used for going to Goa from Kumta and it is highly unbelievable that the appellant- owner has given free service to the claimants.
Therefore, it is proved on all its probability that the Maruti Omni car must have been used on hire basis by receiving fare by Yakoob Ismail Shamali or claimants.
In this regard, appreciation of evidence made by the Tribunal is found to be correct and rightly fastened the liability on the appellant-owner of the Maruti Omni car.
Therefore, this Court does not find any good ground to make interference with the finding given by the Tribunal.
Therefore, the appeals filed by the appellant- owner are liable to be dismissed.
